evidence: The Al2O3 films produced by plasma enhanced atomic layer deposition (PEALD) at the temperatures lower than 150 /C14 C have excellent electrical properties, such as high dielectric constant of w8 (compared with w3.9 for SiO2), low leakage current, high breakdown strength and good thermo-dynamical stability in contact with Si. Also, the Al2O3 films deposited by the low-temperature PEALD are suitable for TFTs on plastic (polymer) substrates used in liquid crystal display (LCD) technology.
